applications.name: [b53442]ERADICATE[-] - Special into Block
applications.description: Whenever the Defender's Block is struck by a Special Attack while they have 10 or more [k=glossary/story_scourge]Scourge Charges[/k], they are [k=glossary/story_eradicate][b53442]Eradicated[-][/k] for 400% of the Attacker's Base Attack. applications.name: [d3832d]THRESHOLD[-] - Falter
